title: poa subcaerulea var. anceps
intro: Poa subcaerulea var. anceps, commonly known as Blue Mountain bluegrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to promote relaxation and reduce stress. The health benefits of Poa subcaerulea var. anceps include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help to protect against chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory properties.
